links.outcome: Actively harmful LLM recommendations and whether they persisted in final documentation
links.effect: Actively harmful recommendations in 115 encounters (7.8%, 95% CI 6.5-9.3), with 67 appearing in the final documentation; clinicians did not modify documentation in 917 encounters (62%).
links.quote: Safety assessments identified actively harmful recommendations from the large language model in 115 encounters (7.8%, 95% CI 6.5-9.3), with 67 such recommendations appearing in the final documentation.

screen.reason: Retrospective audit of a live deployment in 16 Kenyan clinics, evaluating how clinicians acted on LLM clinical decision support recommendations (measuring whether clinician oversight successfully filtered out harmful LLM outputs).
